what: The parser reached the end of the file while it was still inside a block. An opening `{`, `(`, or `[` is missing its closing partner.

street.happen: JavaScript reach the end of your file and e still dey wait. You leave one `}` or `)` open.
street.todo: Count your brackets. Every `{` must get im own `}`.
street.learn: "syntax" na the correct way to arrange code.

normal.happen: JavaScript don reach the end of your file, but e still dey wait for something. Most times, one `}` or `)` no close.
normal.todo: Count your brackets. Every `{` must get one `}`.
normal.learn: "syntax" na the correct way to write code.
